requirement: A Joomla build keeps the tags of the articles it keeps: JA Podcast 190 tag pairings before an Apply, 190 after

oracle.ref: PR #1083 (fix); fix evidence: 08/10/2026, a JA Podcast j6 1.0.1 site: a brief build took #__contentitem_tag_map from 190 rows to 0 (Joomla's Taggable behaviour read an article store naming no tags as every tag removed). Fixed in Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.1 (TracyHQ/claude-cowork c7f4d40), whose own e2e is joomla/cowork/tests/e2e/tags-kept.sh.
oracle.invariant: Test 1 reports ok: no Joomla pin installs a plugin older than 0.24.1 Test 2 reports ok: the Apply wrote tagged articles (some unpublished), no write named tags, deleted a tag or took a category off, and the tag map holds 190 pairings after the Apply, every article with exactly its own tags
